title: Rav Menashya bar Yaakov

paragraphs: [Bava Metzia 26a](https://www.sefaria.org/Bava_Metzia.26a.10-13) mentions Resh Lakish speaking in the name of Bar Kappara, then Rav Menashya bar Yaakov’s answer and Rav Nachman speaking in the name of Rabbah bar Avuha, etc. [Menachot 32a](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.32a.2-3) has Rav Menashya bar Yaakov—or, in another reading, Rav Shmuel bar Yaakov—in a discussion of what Rav Chananel said in the name of Rav. Hyman consequently places him approximately in Rav Nachman’s generation.[^1]

notes.text: The two names in Menachot are alternatives for the speaker who gives the width of the space. [Heilprin’s notice](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2525&lang=en) also cites both passages and associates Menashya with Rav Nachman’s time.
